digest.component_or_area: bridge state store and ADR documentation
propositions: Document the three committed format changes to .bridge_state (last_get_pass relocation, scalar baseline normalization, prev_snapshot narrowing) and the baseline_advanced_at field deletion via ADR 0060.
Bridge state remains committed on the tickets branch because ephemeral GitHub runners require durable state and epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.
Mixed-version protocol reads chronological max(new, legacy) and stops legacy writes after direct deployment evidence; first-wins is unsafe because it can mask stale data.

A2-2 gate requires A2-1 merged, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle to cutover without pass-record version stamps.

Each format change has defined rollback boundaries: A2-1 reversible, A3 reversible through idempotent canonicalization, A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer, and A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Measured format change impact: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1, and 218/399 identical prev key sets, with provenance in session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.
